title: AI × Bio 每日精选
subtitle: 计算生物学、组学、蛋白质与生物医学模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Biological rationales from language models enable leakage-resistant forecasts of target-indication success
items.abstract_or_text: Identifying which target-indication (T-I) hypotheses can translate into clinical success remains a central challenge in drug discovery. We present PRIORITI (Prospective Rationale-Informed Outcome Reasoning for Integrated Target-indication Intelligence), a leakage-resistant framework that separates upstream biological evidence synthesis from outcome prediction. Given only a target gene and disease indication, a domain-instructed large language model (LLM) synthesizes drug-agnostic human genetics across prespecified channels. These evidence were embedded and combined with static entity context derived from gene summaries and disease definitions. The resulting representation is used to fit a supervised model trained on 6,784 temporally curated historical T-I outcomes, which is one of the largest cohorts assembled for this task. On a held-out historical test set of 1,696 T-I pairs, PRIORITI achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.883 and an expected calibration error (ECE) of 0.023, outperforming both a static target and indication context baseline and a human-curated genetic-evidence reference. On a strictly post-cutoff out-of-time benchmark of 765 T-I pairs, the largest such evaluation cohort reported to date, performance remained robust, with ROC-AUC 0.817, PR-AUC 0.357 and ECE 0.044, exceeding static target and indication context baseline and direct zero-shot LLM forecasting. A label-blinded LLM-based explainer further converted locked predictions into auditable prioritization rationales. Together, PRIORITI provides a calibrated, biology-first probability together with decision-oriented rationales for T-I prioritization before downstream translational investment.
items.summary_zh: PRIORITI 以 LLM 整合不依赖具体药物的人类遗传学证据，并在时间外 target-indication 预测中保持校准性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本以 6,784 个时间整理的历史 T-I 结局训练，并在 765 个严格截止日期后的配对上评估；结果支持其作为转化投入前的优先级工具，但不构成靶点临床成功的因果或临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 识别哪些靶点—适应症（T-I）假设能够转化为临床成功，仍是药物发现中的核心挑战。我们提出 PRIORITI（Prospective Rationale-Informed Outcome Reasoning for Integrated Target-indication Intelligence），这是一个抗信息泄漏框架，将上游生物学证据综合与结局预测分离。仅给定一个靶基因和疾病适应症，经过领域指令训练的大语言模型（LLM）便可跨预先指定的通道综合不依赖具体药物的人类遗传学证据。这些证据被嵌入，并与来自基因摘要和疾病定义的静态实体上下文相结合。由此得到的表征用于拟合一个监督模型，该模型在 6,784 个经过时间整理的历史 T-I 结局上训练，是为该任务构建的最大队列之一。在包含 1,696 个 T-I 配对的留出历史测试集上，PRIORITI 达到 0.883 的 ROC-AUC 和 0.023 的期望校准误差（ECE），优于静态靶点和适应症上下文基线，以及人工整理的遗传证据参考。在包含 765 个 T-I 配对的严格截止日期后时间外基准上——这是迄今报告的此类评估中最大的队列——其性能仍然稳健，ROC-AUC 为 0.817、PR-AUC 为 0.357、ECE 为 0.044，超过静态靶点和适应症上下文基线以及直接零样本 LLM 预测。一个标签盲化的基于 LLM 的解释器进一步将锁定的预测转化为可审计的优先级理由。总体而言，PRIORITI 在下游转化投入之前，为 T-I 优先级排序提供了经校准的、以生物学为先的概率及面向决策的理由。

items.title: Combining interstrand crosslinking agents with histone deacetylase inhibitors against high grade IDH mutant gliomas
items.abstract_or_text: Mismatch repair (MMR) deficiency contributes to temozolomide (TMZ) resistance in a subset of isocitrate dehydrogenase 1/2 mutant (IDHmut) gliomas, creating a need for therapies that retain activity despite MMR loss. We evaluated the novel interstrand crosslinking agent KL-50, alone and in combination with the histone deacetylase inhibitor belinostat, in patient-derived IDHmut glioma models. MSH6 knockout or constitutive expression established four matched MMR-proficient and MMR-deficient culture models. Drug responses were assessed using live cell count and cytotoxicity assays, and KL-50 monotherapy was tested in intracranial BT142 orthotopic xenografts. LOEWE synergy analysis, RNA sequencing, and a genome-wide CRISPR knockout screen assessed combination activity and potential mechanisms. MMR deficiency increased TMZ GI values 2.2- to 30.4-fold, whereas KL-50 retained antiproliferative activity and showed enhanced cytotoxicity in selected MMR-deficient models. In TMZ-naive, MMR-proficient BT142 xenografts, KL-50 increased median survival from 107.5 to 194 days. Two of eight treated mice had no histologically detectable residual tumor after 220 days post-engraftment. KL-50 and belinostat exhibited synergistic cytotoxicity in BT142, 905, and TS603 IDHmut glioma cultures. Transcriptomic gene ontology analyses identified downregulation of DNA repair pathways following histone deacetylase inhibition, including terms for homologous recombination and double-strand break repair. The CRISPR screen identified depletion of PKMYT1-targeting gRNAs during KL-50 treatment, implicating this mitotic checkpoint kinase as a candidate determinant of drug sensitivity. PKMYT1 expression was also reduced by histone deacetylase inhibition. These findings support further preclinical development of KL-50, alone and in combination with belinostat, for IDHmut gliomas including tumors with MMR-associated TMZ resistance.
items.summary_zh: KL-50 与 belinostat 在患者来源 IDHmut 胶质瘤模型中显示协同细胞毒性，并在原位异种移植模型中延长生存。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本结合匹配的 MMR 状态培养模型、RNA 测序、CRISPR 筛选和小鼠原位移植，提供了较完整的临床前证据；仍需进一步临床前开发和临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 错配修复（MMR）缺陷会导致一部分异柠檬酸脱氢酶 1/2 突变型（IDHmut）胶质瘤对替莫唑胺（TMZ）耐药，因此需要在 MMR 缺失情况下仍保留活性的治疗方法。我们在患者来源的 IDHmut 胶质瘤模型中评估了新型链间交联剂 KL-50 的单药作用及其与组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂 belinostat 的联用。通过 MSH6 敲除或组成型表达建立了四个相匹配的 MMR 完整和 MMR 缺陷培养模型。采用活细胞计数和细胞毒性试验评估药物反应，并在颅内 BT142 原位异种移植模型中测试 KL-50 单药。采用 LOEWE 协同作用分析、RNA 测序和全基因组 CRISPR 敲除筛选评估联合活性及潜在机制。MMR 缺陷使 TMZ 的 GI 值升高 2.2 至 30.4 倍，而 KL-50 保留了抗增殖活性，并在选定的 MMR 缺陷模型中表现出增强的细胞毒性。在 TMZ 初治、MMR 完整的 BT142 异种移植瘤中，KL-50 将中位生存期从 107.5 天延长至 194 天。8 只接受治疗的小鼠中有 2 只在移植后 220 天未检出组织学可见的残余肿瘤。KL-50 与 belinostat 在 BT142、905 和 TS603 IDHmut 胶质瘤培养物中表现出协同细胞毒性。转录组基因本体分析发现，组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制后 DNA 修复通路下调，包括同源重组和双链断裂修复相关术语。CRISPR 筛选发现，KL-50 治疗期间靶向 PKMYT1 的 gRNA 耗竭，提示该有丝分裂检查点激酶可能是药物敏感性的候选决定因素。组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制同样降低了 PKMYT1 表达。这些发现支持进一步开展 KL-50 单药及其与 belinostat 联用的临床前开发，用于包括具有 MMR 相关 TMZ 耐药肿瘤在内的 IDHmut 胶质瘤。

items.title: Prion Protein Deficiency Results in Synaptic, Neural Network and Behavioral Alterations
items.abstract_or_text: The cellular form of the prion protein (PrPC) is known for its involvement in the pathogenesis of prion diseases. Recent research implicates the physiological isoform of PrP in neuronal development, excitability, and synaptic plasticity, as well as in other biological processes. However, its precise function in the development and function of neurons remains poorly understood. Here, we investigated its role during different developmental stages, both in vitro and in vivo, using different PrP knock-out (KO) mouse lines (Prnp-/-). Prion protein KO neurons cultured on microelectrode arrays (MEAs) displayed altered network dynamics compared to wild type cultures, comprising reduced burst frequency, and abnormal spike patterns, indicative of impaired function of the synaptic circuitry. These functional alterations were associated with a reduced expression of key presynaptic and postsynaptic proteins, including elements of the SNARE complex and regulators of excitation-inhibition balance. Similar molecular changes were also confirmed in a second Prnp-/- model, suggesting that PrPC is directly involved in these mechanisms regardless of genetic backgrounds. Alterations in neuronal networks were traceable into adulthood: in vivo recordings in adult Prnp-/- mice revealed increased neuronal responses to visual danger stimuli, which correlated with behaviorally increased fear responses to those stimuli. Together, our findings support a critical role for PrPC in the maintenance of functional neuronal networks, from mature cortical neurons in vitro to behaviorally mature relevant circuits in vivo, beyond genomic background. These results indicate that PrPC acts as a key regulator of synaptic function both in physiological and pathological conditions.
items.summary_zh: 多个 Prnp-/- 小鼠模型显示 PrPC 缺失伴随突触蛋白、神经网络动力学和恐惧反应改变。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本跨体外 MEA、第二个敲除模型和成年小鼠体内记录给出一致证据，支持 PrPC 与突触功能相关；结果尚不能单独确定其分子机制。
items.abstract_zh: 朊蛋白的细胞形式（PrPC）因参与朊病毒病的发病机制而为人所知。近期研究提示，PrP 的生理同工型参与神经元发育、兴奋性和突触可塑性，以及其他生物过程。然而，其在神经元发育和功能中的确切作用仍知之甚少。我们在体外和体内、使用不同的 PrP 敲除（KO）小鼠品系（Prnp-/-），研究了其在不同发育阶段中的作用。于微电极阵列（MEA）上培养的朊蛋白 KO 神经元与野生型培养物相比表现出改变的网络动力学，包括爆发频率降低和异常放电模式，提示突触回路功能受损。这些功能改变伴随关键突触前和突触后蛋白表达降低，包括 SNARE 复合体元件和兴奋—抑制平衡调节因子。在第二个 Prnp-/- 模型中也证实了类似的分子改变，提示无论遗传背景如何，PrPC 都直接参与这些机制。神经网络改变可追踪至成年期：成年 Prnp-/- 小鼠的体内记录显示，其对视觉危险刺激的神经元反应增加，并与对这些刺激行为上增加的恐惧反应相关。总体而言，我们的发现支持 PrPC 在维持功能性神经网络中具有关键作用，涵盖体外成熟皮层神经元至体内行为成熟的相关回路，且不受遗传背景限制。这些结果表明，PrPC 在生理和病理条件下均是突触功能的关键调节因子。

items.title: Joint recording of past and present transcriptomes reconstructs single-cell trajectories
items.abstract_or_text: Tracing molecular cell state transitions through development, homeostasis and disease is still beyond reach at single-cell resolution. We present scReMeMber-Seq, a methylation-based cell-memory recorder connecting past transcriptional states with present transcriptome and DNA methylome in individual cells. scReMeMber-Seq leverages pulse induction of DCM-Polr2b (TimeMachine) and single-cell methylome-transcriptome (scMT) sequencing for endpoint readout. In mouse neural stem cells (NSCs) and pancreatic organoids, single-cell DCM methylation profiles (scDCMome) accurately discriminate cell types. Over time, scDCMome also record NSC quiescence-activation state changes across multiple cell divisions. In zebrafish embryos, scDCMome resolve individual transcriptional trajectories from progenitor to neuron. Together, scReMeMber-Seq enables real time reconstruction of cellular trajectories, connecting past and present molecular states in single cells, at genome scale, across experimental systems, in vitro and in vivo.
items.summary_zh: scReMeMber-Seq 将甲基化细胞记忆记录与单细胞转录组和甲基组终点读取相连，用于重建细胞轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本在小鼠神经干细胞、胰腺类器官和斑马鱼胚胎中展示跨体外与体内系统的实验应用，为把既往与当前单细胞状态连接起来提供了新测量框架。
items.abstract_zh: 在单细胞分辨率下追踪发育、稳态和疾病过程中的分子细胞状态转换仍难以实现。我们提出 scReMeMber-Seq，这是一种基于甲基化的细胞记忆记录器，可在单个细胞中连接既往转录状态与当前转录组和 DNA 甲基组。scReMeMber-Seq 利用 DCM-Polr2b（TimeMachine）的脉冲诱导和单细胞甲基组—转录组（scMT）测序进行终点读取。在小鼠神经干细胞（NSCs）和胰腺类器官中，单细胞 DCM 甲基化谱（scDCMome）可准确区分细胞类型。随时间推移，scDCMome 还可记录跨多个细胞分裂的 NSC 静息—激活状态变化。在斑马鱼胚胎中，scDCMome 解析了从祖细胞到神经元的个体转录轨迹。总体而言，scReMeMber-Seq 能够在体外和体内实验系统中、在全基因组尺度上实时重建细胞轨迹，连接单细胞中过去与当前的分子状态。

items.title: ELITE: E3 Ligase Inference for Tissue specific Elimination: A LLM Based E3 Ligase Prediction System for Precise Targeted Protein Degradation
items.abstract_or_text: Targeted protein degradation (TPD) has transformed modern drug discovery by harnessing the ubiquitin-proteasome system to eliminate disease-driving proteins previously deemed undruggable. However, current approaches predominantly rely on a narrow set of ubiquitously expressed E3 ligases, such as Cereblon (CRBN) and Von Hippel-Lindau (VHL), which limits tissue specificity, increases systemic toxicity, and fosters resistance. Here, we present an AI-driven framework for the rational identification of tissue-specific E3 ligases suitable for precision-targeted degradation. Our model leverages an BERT-based protein language architecture trained on billions of sequences to generate contextual embeddings that capture structural and functional motifs relevant for E3-substrate compatibility. By integrating these embeddings with tissue-resolved protein-protein interaction data, the framework predicts ligase-target interactions that are both biologically plausible and context-restricted. This enables the prioritization of ligases capable of driving selective degradation of pathogenic proteins within disease-relevant tissues. The proposed approach offers a scalable path to expand the E3 ligase repertoire and advance TPD toward true precision medicine. The AI architecture used in this study builds upon a well-established, state-of-the-art protein language modeling framework rather than introducing a fundamentally new model design. The principal contribution instead lies in the deliberate engineering of a task-specific dataset that integrates large-scale protein sequence embeddings with tissue-resolved expression and interaction information tailored to targeted protein degradation. By curating and harmonizing these heterogeneous data modalities for the explicit purpose of identifying tissue-selective E3 ligases, we enable a generalizable foundation model to be effectively adapted to a previously unexplored application context. This data-centric advance underpins the framework's ability to generate biologically meaningful, context-aware predictions and represents a central contribution of the present work.
items.summary_zh: ELITE 将蛋白质语言模型嵌入与组织分辨的表达和 PPI 数据整合，以优先筛选组织特异性 E3 ligase。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本的数据工程面向精确靶向蛋白降解中的组织选择性问题；摘要未报告独立实验验证或定量基准，因此预测仍应视为候选优先级。
items.abstract_zh: 靶向蛋白降解（TPD）通过利用泛素—蛋白酶体系统清除先前被认为不可成药的疾病驱动蛋白，已改变现代药物发现。然而，当前方法主要依赖少数广泛表达的 E3 ligase，例如 Cereblon（CRBN）和 Von Hippel-Lindau（VHL），这限制了组织特异性、增加了全身毒性并促进耐药。这里，我们提出一个 AI 驱动框架，用于理性识别适合精确靶向降解的组织特异性 E3 ligase。我们的模型利用在数十亿条序列上训练的基于 BERT 的蛋白质语言架构，生成可捕捉与 E3—底物兼容性相关的结构和功能基序的上下文嵌入。通过将这些嵌入与组织分辨的蛋白质—蛋白质相互作用数据整合，该框架预测在生物学上合理且受情境限制的 ligase—靶标相互作用。这使得能够优先筛选可在疾病相关组织内驱动病原蛋白选择性降解的 ligase。该方法为扩展 E3 ligase 谱系并推动 TPD 迈向真正的精准医学提供了可扩展路径。本研究使用的 AI 架构建立在成熟、最先进的蛋白质语言建模框架之上，而非引入根本性的新模型设计。其主要贡献在于审慎构建了一个任务特异性数据集：它整合大规模蛋白质序列嵌入，以及为靶向蛋白降解定制的组织分辨表达与相互作用信息。通过为明确识别组织选择性 E3 ligase 的目的整理并协调这些异质数据模态，我们使一个通用基础模型得以有效适配到此前未探索的应用情境。这一以数据为中心的进展支撑了该框架生成具有生物学意义、具情境感知的预测能力，并构成本研究的核心贡献。
items.author_line: Patjoshi, S., Froehlich, H., Madan, S.

items.title: Integration of Multidimensional Genetic and Single- Cell Analyses to Identify Potential Drug Targets and a Clinical Risk Prediction Model for Cervical Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background : Genetic susceptibility to cervical cancer is closely associated with dysregulation of the tumor microenvironment. However, genetic mapping, causal inference, and single-cell functional characterization have rarely been integrated within a unified analytical framework, limiting the translational potential of candidate therapeutic targets. Methods : This study integrated conditional and joint association analysis (COJO), Multi-marker Analysis of GenoMic Annotation (MAGMA), two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR), differential expression analysis, chromosomal mapping, gene correlation analysis, immune infiltration analysis, gene-immune cell association analysis, machine learning, and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq). COJO and MAGMA were first used to identify cervical cancer susceptibility genes and independent genetic signals from genome-wide association study (GWAS) data. MR was then performed to assess potential causal associations between gene expression and cervical cancer. Differential expression and genomic localization analyses were used to prioritize core genes. Their potential immune-related mechanisms were investigated through immune infiltration and gene-immune cell association analyses. Machine-learning models were used to evaluate predictive performance and construct a nomogram. Finally, scRNA-seq was used to characterize the cell-type-specific expression of the prioritized genes. Results : COJO and MAGMA identified 12 independent genetic signals corresponding to eight susceptibility genes. MR supported associations of genetically predicted expression of SERPINB13 (IVW: OR = 1.72, 95% CI = 1.48-1.99, P = 2.3 x 10^-8), PDCD1LG2 (IVW: OR = 1.58, 95% CI = 1.35-1.85, P = 7.6 x 10^-7), SERPINF2 (IVW: OR = 1.45, 95% CI = 1.23-1.71, P = 3.1 x 10^-5), and MMP1 (IVW: OR = 1.36, 95% CI = 1.15-1.61, P = 4.8 x 10^-4) with cervical cancer. All four genes were significantly upregulated in cervical cancer tissues (FDR 0.5, P Conclusions : This multidimensional analysis identified SERPINB13, PDCD1LG2, SERPINF2, and MMP1 as candidate therapeutic targets and potential predictors of cervical cancer. The findings suggest that these genes may contribute to cervical carcinogenesis through immune-microenvironment regulation and may support future risk-stratification research. Experimental and prospective clinical validation is required before clinical application.
items.summary_zh: 研究整合 GWAS、MR、机器学习与 scRNA-seq，提出 SERPINB13、PDCD1LG2、SERPINF2 和 MMP1 为宫颈癌候选靶点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本整合遗传关联、单细胞定位和风险建模；MR 结果支持遗传预测表达与宫颈癌的关联，但作者明确指出仍需实验和前瞻性临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：宫颈癌的遗传易感性与肿瘤微环境失调密切相关。然而，遗传定位、因果推断和单细胞功能表征很少在统一分析框架中整合，从而限制了候选治疗靶点的转化潜力。方法：本研究整合了条件与联合关联分析（COJO）、基因组注释多标记分析（MAGMA）、双样本孟德尔随机化（MR）、差异表达分析、染色体定位、基因相关性分析、免疫浸润分析、基因—免疫细胞关联分析、机器学习和单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）。首先使用 COJO 和 MAGMA 从全基因组关联研究（GWAS）数据中识别宫颈癌易感基因和独立遗传信号。随后进行 MR，以评估基因表达与宫颈癌之间潜在的因果关联。利用差异表达和基因组定位分析优先筛选核心基因。通过免疫浸润和基因—免疫细胞关联分析，考察其潜在的免疫相关机制。使用机器学习模型评估预测性能并构建列线图。最后，利用 scRNA-seq 表征优先基因的细胞类型特异性表达。结果：COJO 和 MAGMA 识别出 12 个独立遗传信号，对应 8 个易感基因。MR 支持遗传预测的 SERPINB13（IVW：OR = 1.72，95% CI = 1.48-1.99，P = 2.3 x 10^-8）、PDCD1LG2（IVW：OR = 1.58，95% CI = 1.35-1.85，P = 7.6 x 10^-7）、SERPINF2（IVW：OR = 1.45，95% CI = 1.23-1.71，P = 3.1 x 10^-5）和 MMP1（IVW：OR = 1.36，95% CI = 1.15-1.61，P = 4.8 x 10^-4）表达与宫颈癌之间的关联。四个基因在宫颈癌组织中均显著上调（FDR 0.5，P）。结论：该多维分析将 SERPINB13、PDCD1LG2、SERPINF2 和 MMP1 识别为宫颈癌候选治疗靶点和潜在预测因子。研究结果提示，这些基因可能通过免疫微环境调控参与宫颈癌发生，并可能支持未来风险分层研究。在临床应用前仍需要实验和前瞻性临床验证。
items.author_line: Li L, Zhao C, Lang Y, Zhou X, Jia P, Guo X, Wang Q

items.title: An Integrated Analysis of Manganese Metabolism-Related Genes and Their Association With Biomarkers, Immune Infiltration, and Clinical Subtypes in Alzheimer's Disease.
items.abstract_or_text: Alzheimer's disease (AD), a neurodegenerative condition marked by amyloid-beta plaques and tau protein neurofibrillary tangles, progresses against a backdrop of essential biological processes. Manganese, an indispensable trace element for vital functions including energy metabolism and antioxidant defense, is integral to neurological health. Its precise metabolic role throughout the course of AD pathogenesis is not fully elucidated. Four essential manganese metabolism-related genes were identified as diagnostic markers through a multi-omic framework. This approach integrated Weighted Gene Co-Expression Network Analysis with machine learning ensembles (Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator/Random Forest/Extreme Gradient Boosting), followed by rigorous testing in an independent dataset. Beyond identification, we utilized CIBERSORT and ssGSEA to characterize immune infiltration and leveraged GSEA/GO/KEGG for pathway elucidation. Finally, AD patients were stratified into molecular subgroups based on these hub genes, and their underlying regulatory networks involving miRNAs and transcription factors were reconstructed. An integrated bioinformatics framework identified 12 differentially expressed genes related to manganese metabolism in AD. Machine-learning-based feature selection further pinpointed four key diagnostic biomarkers (TSPO, PTBP1, GLO1, and ACACB) with high discriminative power (AUC: 0.831-0.905). Immune infiltration analysis revealed substantial immune remodeling in AD, including an elevation of naïve B cells. Moreover, AD samples were classified into two molecular subtypes displaying distinct immune and metabolic characteristics, and regulatory miRNA/TF interaction networks were constructed for the core genes. Our results shed new light on the molecular mechanisms underlying AD and support future efforts toward early diagnosis and personalized therapeutic interventions based on molecular subtypes.
items.summary_zh: 这项同行评审研究在独立数据集测试后，将 TSPO、PTBP1、GLO1 和 ACACB 识别为 AD 的锰代谢相关诊断标志物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究有独立数据集测试并报告 AUC 0.831-0.905，但结果主要为组学与机器学习关联，尚不能证明锰代谢基因驱动 AD 或可直接指导治疗。
items.abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种以 amyloid-beta 斑块和 tau 蛋白神经原纤维缠结为标志的神经退行性疾病，其进展发生在关键生物过程的背景之中。锰是能量代谢和抗氧化防御等重要功能所必需的微量元素，对神经健康不可或缺。锰代谢在 AD 发病过程中所起的确切作用尚未完全阐明。通过多组学框架，我们将四个关键锰代谢相关基因识别为诊断标志物。该方法将加权基因共表达网络分析与机器学习集成方法（Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator/Random Forest/Extreme Gradient Boosting）整合，随后在独立数据集中进行严格测试。除标志物识别外，我们还采用 CIBERSORT 和 ssGSEA 表征免疫浸润，并利用 GSEA/GO/KEGG 阐释通路。最后，基于这些枢纽基因将 AD 患者分为分子亚组，并重建了涉及 miRNA 和转录因子的底层调控网络。整合生物信息学框架识别出 AD 中 12 个与锰代谢相关的差异表达基因。基于机器学习的特征选择进一步确定了 4 个具有高判别力的关键诊断生物标志物（TSPO、PTBP1、GLO1 和 ACACB；AUC：0.831-0.905）。免疫浸润分析显示 AD 存在显著免疫重塑，包括初始 B 细胞升高。此外，AD 样本被分为两个具有不同免疫和代谢特征的分子亚型，并为核心基因构建了调控 miRNA/TF 相互作用网络。我们的结果为 AD 的分子机制提供了新见解，并支持基于分子亚型推进早期诊断和个体化治疗干预的未来工作。
items.author_line: Shu S, Hu J, Hu S, Yao Y

items.title: Identification and experimental validation of biomarkers associated with lipotoxicity in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease through transcriptomic and single-cell RNA sequencing analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Studies have suggested that lipotoxicity may play a significant role in the etiology of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). However, the precise involvement of lipotoxicity-related genes (LRGs) in COPD remains unclear. This study aimed to identify and validate biomarkers associated with LRGs in COPD, potentially paving the way for the development of targeted therapeutic strategies. Methods In the study, COPD-related datasets were sourced from a public database. Biomarkers were ascertained through differential expression analysis, machine learning, and gene expression analyses. A nomogram was developed and evaluated based on these biomarkers. To further explore the underlying biological mechanisms of COPD, functional enrichment analysis, immune infiltration analysis, drug prediction, single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), and reverse transcription quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR) analyses were conducted. Results APRT and S100A8 were ascertained as biomarkers for COPD. Notably, APRT exhibited notably lower expression in COPD samples, while S100A8 showed notably higher expression. RT-qPCR analysis further supported these findings. A nomogram was then developed and validated, with the calibration curve indicating its effective ability to predict COPD risk (P = 0.395 in the Hosmer-Lemeshow test). Both biomarkers were found to be significantly co-enriched in the "focal adhesion" pathway. Additionally, 3 immune cell types with notably differential infiltration were identified, and both APRT and S100A8 showed a significant correlation with neutrophils. Furthermore, 27 drugs (such as alteplase and relaxin) targeting APRT, as well as methotrexate targeting S100A8, were predicted. Finally, scRNA-seq analysis ascertained macrophages as a key cell type in COPD. Dynamic expression patterns of both biomarkers were observed during macrophage differentiation: APRT first increases, then decreases, and increases again, while S100A8 initially rises and then declines. Conclusion This study ascertained APRT and S100A8 as biomarkers associated with lipotoxicity in COPD, providing valuable insights that could aid in the development of targeted therapies.
items.summary_zh: 公共队列、scRNA-seq 与 RT-qPCR 将 APRT 和 S100A8 提出为与 COPD 脂毒性相关的候选标志物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本包含 RT-qPCR 支持和单细胞表达动态，但药物仅为计算预测，标志物及靶向治疗价值仍需外部队列和功能实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：研究提示脂毒性可能在慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的病因学中发挥重要作用。然而，脂毒性相关基因（LRGs）在 COPD 中的确切参与情况仍不清楚。本研究旨在识别并验证 COPD 中与 LRGs 相关的生物标志物，可能为靶向治疗策略的开发铺平道路。方法：研究从公共数据库获取 COPD 相关数据集。通过差异表达分析、机器学习和基因表达分析确定生物标志物。基于这些标志物建立并评估了一个列线图。为进一步探索 COPD 的潜在生物学机制，进行了功能富集分析、免疫浸润分析、药物预测、单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）和逆转录定量 PCR（RT-qPCR）分析。结果：APRT 和 S100A8 被确定为 COPD 的生物标志物。值得注意的是，APRT 在 COPD 样本中的表达显著较低，而 S100A8 的表达显著较高。RT-qPCR 分析进一步支持了这些发现。随后建立并验证了一个列线图，校准曲线显示其具有有效预测 COPD 风险的能力（Hosmer-Lemeshow 检验 P = 0.395）。发现两个标志物均在“focal adhesion”通路中显著共同富集。此外，识别出 3 种浸润显著不同的免疫细胞类型，且 APRT 和 S100A8 均与中性粒细胞显著相关。进一步预测出靶向 APRT 的 27 种药物（如 alteplase 和 relaxin），以及靶向 S100A8 的 methotrexate。最后，scRNA-seq 分析将巨噬细胞确定为 COPD 中的关键细胞类型。在巨噬细胞分化过程中观察到两个标志物的动态表达模式：APRT 先升高、后降低、再升高，而 S100A8 最初升高后下降。结论：本研究将 APRT 和 S100A8 确定为与 COPD 脂毒性相关的生物标志物，为可能有助于开发靶向疗法提供了有价值的见解。
items.author_line: Li j, Luo X, Zhang X, Zhao Q, Wang R

items.title: BiomiX 3.0: A user-friendly platform for democratized multi-omics integration with graph-based learning.
items.abstract_or_text: Background Multi-omics integration has emerged as a powerful strategy to decode the molecular complexity of biological systems. However, the diversity of available methods, each designed with distinct assumptions, objectives, and computational requirements, makes method selection, usage and interpretation challenging for nonexpert users. Here we present BiomiX 3.0, an updated version of the BiomiX platform that extends its integration capabilities with four additional methods: Similarity Network Fusion (SNF), NEighborhood-based Multi-Omics clustering (NEMO), Data Integration Analysis for Biomarker discovery using Latent variable approaches for Omics studies (DIABLO), and PRAMIGO (Phenotyping netwoRk Application for Multi-omics InteGratiOn), a novel supervised heterogeneous graph transformer (HGT) introduced in this work. Results We benchmarked all five methods, MOFA, DIABLO, SNF, NEMO, and PRAMIGO, on two independent multiomics datasets derived from a Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) cohort comparing IGHV-mutated and unmutated patients, and a pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) cohort versus healthy controls. Supervised methods (DIABLO, PRAMIGO) consistently achieved higher condition-specific discrimination as measured by the Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) and the Adjusted Mutual Information (AMI). In contrast, unsupervised methods (SNF, NEMO) revealed alternative patient stratifications driven by independent sources of biological variance while MOFA performed in a semi-supervised way occupies an intermediate position, capturing latent factors that explain both disease-associated and orthogonal sources of variance. Systematic gene-centric analysis of the top-ranked features prioritized by each method was supported by manual biological annotation of shared and method-specific signals. Across cohorts, we annotated 154 shared features (116 genes, 38 metabolites) and 60 method-unique features per cohort, demonstrating that no single integration strategy captures the full landscape of biologically relevant signals. In the CLL cohort, shared features spanned B-cell receptor biology, innate immune signaling, RAS/MAPK activation, and epigenetic regulation, while methodunique features revealed supervised-method-specific insights into vesicle trafficking (DIABLO), immune checkpoints (MOFA), and ncRNA regulation (PRAMIGO). In the PTB cohort, a convergent interferon/innate immune signature dominated shared features across all methods. Still, method-unique analysis uncovered DIABLO-specific acylcarnitine metabolic reprogramming, MOFA-specific restoration of lysosomal trafficking, and PRAMIGO-specific {gamma}{delta} T-cell and immunoglobulin repertoire diversity. Across both cohorts, SNF and NEMO proved useful for detecting biological and technical sources of variation that were orthogonal to the primary condition of interest. Ultimately, PRAMIGO uniquely enables the construction of heterogeneous graphs modeling cross-modal molecular interactions, uncovering epigenetic co-regulation programs in CLL and multi-omics inflammatory modules in PTB that are difficult to identify using conventional integration approaches. Conclusions BiomiX 3.0 provides a graphical user interface (GUI) multi-method integration environment that democratizes access to state-of-the-art multi-omics analysis. By combining both unsupervised and supervised integration strategies within a unified platform and introducing graph-based learning through PRAMIGO, BiomiX 3.0 enables researchers across disciplines with complementary tools to interrogate the biological sources of variation in their data, without requiring bioinformatics expertise.
items.summary_zh: BiomiX 3.0 在统一 GUI 中比较五种多组学整合方法，并新增异质图 Transformer PRAMIGO。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本在两个独立多组学队列比较方法，并保留不同方法得到的互补信号；它支持方法选择应与研究问题相匹配，而非宣称单一方案普遍最优。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：多组学整合已成为解码生物系统分子复杂性的强大策略。然而，可用方法具有不同的假设、目标和计算要求，这种多样性使非专业用户难以选择、使用和解释方法。这里我们提出 BiomiX 3.0，这是 BiomiX 平台的更新版本，通过另外四种方法扩展其整合能力：Similarity Network Fusion（SNF）、NEighborhood-based Multi-Omics clustering（NEMO）、Data Integration Analysis for Biomarker discovery using Latent variable approaches for Omics studies（DIABLO），以及本研究引入的新型监督式异质图 Transformer（HGT）PRAMIGO（Phenotyping netwoRk Application for Multi-omics InteGratiOn）。结果：我们在两个独立多组学数据集上对五种方法 MOFA、DIABLO、SNF、NEMO 和 PRAMIGO 进行了基准测试；这两个数据集分别来自比较 IGHV 突变和未突变患者的慢性淋巴细胞白血病（CLL）队列，以及比较肺结核（PTB）队列与健康对照的队列。由调整兰德指数（ARI）和调整互信息（AMI）衡量，监督方法（DIABLO、PRAMIGO）始终获得更高的条件特异性判别能力。相比之下，无监督方法（SNF、NEMO）揭示了由独立生物变异来源驱动的替代患者分层；而 MOFA 以半监督方式运行，处于中间位置，捕捉同时解释疾病相关和正交变异来源的潜在因子。对每种方法优先筛选的高排名特征进行了系统的以基因为中心的分析，并以对共享和方法特异性信号的人工生物学注释作为支持。跨队列而言，我们注释了 154 个共享特征（116 个基因、38 个代谢物）及每个队列 60 个方法独有特征，表明没有单一整合策略能捕捉具有生物学相关性的信号全貌。在 CLL 队列中，共享特征涵盖 B 细胞受体生物学、固有免疫信号、RAS/MAPK 激活和表观遗传调控，而方法独有特征揭示了囊泡转运（DIABLO）、免疫检查点（MOFA）和 ncRNA 调控（PRAMIGO）方面的监督方法特异性见解。在 PTB 队列中，趋同的 interferon/固有免疫特征主导了各方法的共享信号。尽管如此，方法独有分析揭示了 DIABLO 特异的 acylcarnitine 代谢重编程、MOFA 特异的 lysosomal trafficking 恢复，以及 PRAMIGO 特异的 {gamma}{delta} T 细胞和免疫球蛋白受体库多样性。跨两个队列，SNF 和 NEMO 均证明可用于检测与主要关注条件正交的生物学和技术变异来源。最终，PRAMIGO 独特地能够构建模拟跨模态分子相互作用的异质图，发现 CLL 中难以用常规整合方法识别的表观遗传共调控程序和 PTB 中的多组学炎症模块。结论：BiomiX 3.0 提供了一个图形用户界面（GUI）多方法整合环境，使最先进的多组学分析更易获得。通过在统一平台中结合无监督和监督整合策略，并通过 PRAMIGO 引入图学习，BiomiX 3.0 使不同学科的研究人员能够利用互补工具考察数据中生物学变异的来源，而不需要生物信息学专业知识。
items.author_line: Clemente-Larramendi, I., Gliozzo, J., Velo-Suarez, L., Bocher, O., Foulquier, N., Hernandez-Valladares, M., Legault, M.-A., Cornec, D., Jamin, C., Gil-de-la-Fuente, A., Fernandez-Ochoa, A., Iperi, C.

items.title: ScProteoAgent enables natural-language-driven single-cell proteomics analysis and interpretation
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell proteomics requires computational choices to remain aligned with experimental design as research questions evolve. Here we present ScProteoAgent, which translates natural-language requests into domain-specific calculations and preserves research intent, analysis design, matrix-processing history and statistical outputs as reusable analytical state. Follow-up requests reuse applicable inputs and initiate new calculations when contrasts or experimental units change. We assembled a benchmark comprising 55 tasks and 33 reference conclusions from 11 published studies, combining progressive questions within studies with complementary biological and analytical settings. In a retrospective comparison of 88 archived outputs from eight systems, ScProteoAgent achieved the highest mean score of 93.67 under a common six-dimensional rule-based evaluation. A HeLa migration case connected phenotype composition with proteomic clusters, candidate differences and original-observation support. In liver zonation, a researcher-guided follow-up reused a saved matrix to test mouse-level spatial contrasts and compare full-matrix and observed-only results. Applications in brain development, sample preservation and hematopoiesis illustrated how interpretation depends on processing choices and experimental units. ScProteoAgent connects research questions with statistical results and their analytical context, enabling existing analyses to support more specific biological investigations.
items.summary_zh: ScProteoAgent 将自然语言请求映射至单细胞蛋白质组计算，并保留可复用的分析状态和统计上下文。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本基于 11 项已发表研究构建 55 个任务基准，并对八个系统的 88 份历史输出作回顾比较；其表现仍依赖规则评估与既有研究数据。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞蛋白质组学要求计算选择随着研究问题演变而始终与实验设计保持一致。这里我们提出 ScProteoAgent，它将自然语言请求转化为领域特异性计算，并将研究意图、分析设计、矩阵处理历史和统计输出保留为可复用的分析状态。后续请求会复用适用的输入，并在对比或实验单位变化时启动新的计算。我们构建了一个基准，包含来自 11 项已发表研究的 55 个任务和 33 条参考结论，将同一研究中逐步推进的问题与互补的生物学和分析情境相结合。在对来自八个系统的 88 份归档输出进行回顾性比较时，ScProteoAgent 在统一的六维规则评估下取得最高平均分 93.67。一个 HeLa 迁移案例将表型组成与蛋白质组簇、候选差异及原始观察支持联系起来。在肝脏分带研究中，研究者指导的后续分析复用了已保存的矩阵，以检验小鼠水平的空间对比，并比较全矩阵和仅观察结果。在脑发育、样本保存和造血中的应用说明，解释如何取决于处理选择和实验单位。ScProteoAgent 将研究问题与统计结果及其分析语境联系起来，使现有分析能够支持更具体的生物学研究。
items.author_line: Hu, R., Ding, K., Wang, W., Zhu, Z., Chen, P., Wang, S., Wang, Y.

items.title: NeuroDyn-EEG: An Interpretable Pre-trained Model for EEG Based on Neural Dynamics
items.abstract_or_text: Clinical scalp electroencephalography (EEG) offers a noninvasive window into neural dynamics of neuropsychiatric disorders. However, discriminative deep models often lack anatomically indexed physiological interpretability. We propose NeuroDyn-EEG, a pretraining framework integrating generative priors from neural dynamics. It couples an extended Jansen-Rit neural mass model, leadfield-based source projection, and simulation-based parameter inversion. Trained on synthetic parameter-EEG pairs within physiological ranges, NeuroDyn-EEG estimates 11 regional parameter families across 90 AAL regions plus one global parameter from standard 19-channel EEG, using only ~2.43M trainable parameters. We evaluate the framework across three levels. First, controlled simulations demonstrate robust parameter recovery under diverse noise conditions, while real resting-state EEG evaluations confirm spectral and phase consistency in an inverse-forward closed loop. Second, on four clinical benchmarks (AD65, PD31, Figshare MDD, and TUAB), NeuroDyn-EEG achieves competitive classification performance, securing the highest BACC, AUROC, and AUCPR on PD31 and MDD, and highest BACC on AD65. Third, post hoc regional analyses reveal disease-specific alterations: local synaptic connectivity C_1 involves the most altered regions in AD65, whereas the firing threshold theta ranks first in MDD, offering testable mechanistic hypotheses. Overall, NeuroDyn-EEG maps scalp EEG to anatomically indexed dynamical parameters, bridging representation learning and mechanistic neurophysiology. Code: https://github.com/Gnosis-Neurodynamics/NeuroDyn-EEG.
items.summary_zh: NeuroDyn-EEG 用神经动力学生成先验将 19 导 EEG 映射为解剖定位的动力学参数，并在四个临床基准中评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本同时报告仿真参数恢复、闭环一致性、临床基准分类和公开代码；疾病相关参数是可检验的机制假设，不是已确认的病理机制或临床诊断工具。
items.abstract_zh: 临床头皮脑电图（EEG）为观察神经精神疾病的神经动力学提供了无创窗口。然而，判别式深度模型通常缺乏按解剖位置索引的生理可解释性。我们提出 NeuroDyn-EEG，一个整合神经动力学生成先验的预训练框架。它结合扩展的 Jansen-Rit 神经质量模型、基于 leadfield 的源投影和基于仿真的参数反演。NeuroDyn-EEG 在生理范围内的合成参数—EEG 配对数据上训练，仅使用约 2.43M 个可训练参数，即可从标准 19 导 EEG 估计 90 个 AAL 区域的 11 类区域参数及 1 个全局参数。我们在三个层面评估该框架。首先，受控仿真显示其在多种噪声条件下可稳健恢复参数，而真实静息态 EEG 评估在逆—正向闭环中确认了频谱和相位一致性。其次，在四个临床基准（AD65、PD31、Figshare MDD 和 TUAB）上，NeuroDyn-EEG 获得有竞争力的分类性能，在 PD31 和 MDD 上取得最高 BACC、AUROC 和 AUCPR，在 AD65 上取得最高 BACC。第三，事后区域分析揭示了疾病特异性改变：局部突触连接 C_1 涉及 AD65 中改变最多的区域，而放电阈值 theta 在 MDD 中排名第一，提供了可检验的机制假设。总体而言，NeuroDyn-EEG 将头皮 EEG 映射至按解剖位置索引的动力学参数，连接表征学习与机制性神经生理学。代码：https://github.com/Gnosis-Neurodynamics/NeuroDyn-EEG。
items.author_line: Yi Cui, Tong Zhao, Jiaxin Lei, Chuyi Yang, Yifan Cui, Ling Zhang, Yuxiang Yan, Bo Hong

items.title: Interoperability of standardised electronic healthcare records facilitates transfer learning of clinical language models
items.abstract_or_text: Objectives: To investigate whether standardising electronic healthcare record (EHR) data to the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) common data model improves cross-dataset interoperability and enables transfer learning of clinical language models for prediction tasks. Materials and Methods: We used two UK datasets: Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) Aurum, restricted to London, and CPRD GOLD, covering all of England. Each dataset was independently mapped to OMOP standard concepts. A BERT-based transformer was pretrained on GOLD and fine-tuned on both datasets separately to predict 30-day emergency hospital readmission. An ablation study assessed the contribution of the three largest OMOP domains. Results: OMOP mapping was successful for 95.6% of CPRD GOLD and 86.2% of Aurum records. Models fine-tuned on Aurum achieved comparable or superior performance (AUC: 0.93, 95% CI 0.93-0.93) than models fine-tuned on GOLD (AUC: 0.91, 95% CI 0.91-0.92). Ablation results diverged between datasets: GOLD performed better without measurements, while Aurum performed better without drugs. Discussion: OMOP standardisation enabled effective transfer learning across datasets even in the presence of meaningful demographic differences, including ethnic composition and socioeconomic status. Divergence in ablation findings suggests that structural and content differences between primary care datasets influence downstream model behaviour. Incomplete vocabulary coverage within clinical language models also introduced data loss, representing a practical limitation for real-world deployment. Conclusion: OMOP standardisation supported interoperability and transfer learning for clinical prediction using language model with high predictive performance.
items.summary_zh: 在两个英国 CPRD 数据集中，OMOP 标准化支持临床语言模型迁移学习，用于 30 天急诊再入院预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本报告真实 EHR 数据映射、跨数据集微调及消融结果；模型性能不能直接说明可部署性，词表覆盖不足和数据集结构差异仍是现实限制。
items.abstract_zh: 目标：探究将电子健康记录（EHR）数据标准化为 Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership（OMOP）通用数据模型，是否能改善跨数据集互操作性，并使临床语言模型能够进行预测任务的迁移学习。材料与方法：我们使用两个英国数据集：仅限伦敦的 Clinical Practice Research Datalink（CPRD）Aurum，以及覆盖全英格兰的 CPRD GOLD。每个数据集均被独立映射到 OMOP 标准概念。一个基于 BERT 的 Transformer 在 GOLD 上预训练，并分别在两个数据集上微调，以预测 30 天急诊住院再入院。消融研究评估了三个最大 OMOP 域的贡献。结果：CPRD GOLD 的 95.6% 记录和 Aurum 的 86.2% 记录成功完成 OMOP 映射。在 Aurum 上微调的模型表现与在 GOLD 上微调的模型相当或更优（AUC：0.93，95% CI 0.93-0.93；相对 GOLD 的 AUC：0.91，95% CI 0.91-0.92）。两个数据集的消融结果不同：GOLD 在移除测量数据后表现更好，而 Aurum 在移除药物数据后表现更好。讨论：即使存在包括族群构成和社会经济地位在内的显著人口学差异，OMOP 标准化仍支持跨数据集的有效迁移学习。消融结果的差异表明，初级保健数据集之间的结构和内容差异会影响下游模型行为。临床语言模型内不完整的词表覆盖也造成数据丢失，构成真实世界部署的实际限制。结论：OMOP 标准化支持用于临床预测的语言模型的互操作性和迁移学习，并取得较高预测性能。

items.title: Recursive LLM Degradation in Biomedical Question Answering: A Cross-Generation Study
items.abstract_or_text: Repeatedly training language models on their own generated data may create a synthetic-data feedback loop in which errors and distributional biases are reintroduced into subsequent training datasets. This paper studies that process in biomedical question answering (QA) using PubMedQA and two Qwen2.5 model sizes, 0.5B and 3B parameters. The study compares a recursive synthetic-data condition, in which generation G(k+1) is trained on answers produced by G(k), against a Human-Control condition that repeatedly uses the original human training data. The study evaluates across four generations from G0-G3 with two random seeds (42 and 123) and a fixed evaluation set of 1,000 expert-labeled samples. The evaluation includes disease and chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, lexical and semantic similarity, answer length, repetition rate, and other evaluation metrics. The Recursive condition for both model sizes and both seeds showed larger declines than the Human-Control condition in disease entity F1, chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, ROUGE-L, and cosine similarity. Under the fixed no-repeat 3-gram decoding constraint, the main observed behavioral change was increased answer length, while the measured 3-gram repetition rate did not increase. The magnitude of the difference-in-change was larger for the 3B model than for the 0.5B model. This difference was particularly apparent in disease F1, context-supported rate, cosine similarity, and answer length. These results show domain-specific changes associated with using recursive synthetic-data training in biomedical QA, but do not establish clinical hallucination rates or universal model collapse.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在 PubMedQA 上发现，递归使用模型合成答案训练会降低生物医学 QA 的实体和上下文支持指标。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本使用两个 Qwen2.5 规模、两个随机种子、四代训练和固定专家标注评测集；作者明确表示结果不建立临床幻觉率或普遍模型崩塌。
items.abstract_zh: 反复在语言模型自身生成的数据上训练，可能形成一个合成数据反馈循环，其中错误和分布偏差会被重新引入后续训练数据集。本文使用 PubMedQA 和两种 Qwen2.5 模型规模——0.5B 和 3B 参数——研究这一过程在生物医学问答（QA）中的表现。研究比较了递归合成数据条件——第 G(k+1) 代在第 G(k) 代生成的答案上训练——与人类对照条件，后者反复使用原始人工训练数据。研究以两个随机种子（42 和 123）和包含 1,000 个专家标注样本的固定评估集，跨 G0-G3 四代进行评估。评估包括疾病和化学实体 F1、上下文支持率、词汇与语义相似性、答案长度、重复率和其他评估指标。对于两种模型规模和两个随机种子，递归条件在疾病实体 F1、化学实体 F1、上下文支持率、ROUGE-L 和余弦相似性方面均显示出比人类对照条件更大的下降。在固定的无重复 3-gram 解码约束下，观察到的主要行为变化是答案长度增加，而测得的 3-gram 重复率没有增加。3B 模型的变化差异幅度大于 0.5B 模型。这种差异在疾病 F1、上下文支持率、余弦相似性和答案长度上尤其明显。这些结果显示，在生物医学 QA 中使用递归合成数据训练与领域特异性变化相关，但并不确立临床幻觉率或普遍的模型崩塌。

items.title: Inferring division-associated stochasticity from time-series single-cell transcriptomes
items.abstract_or_text: Cell division is fundamental to multicellular organisms, and stochastic partitioning of cellular components can strongly affect genome-wide gene expression. However, how cell division-associated stochasticity shapes cellular dynamics is poorly understood. Here, we propose scDIVIDE, a neural stochastic differential equation framework to jointly infer division rates and continuous cellular dynamics from time-series single-cell RNA sequencing data. We combined birth-death-mutation processes from population genetics with dynamical optimal transport and revealed that the birth (division) rate is embedded in the diffusion coefficient. scDIVIDE accurately inferred birth rates in synthetic data and the inferred birth rates recapitulated turnover-related programs in mouse hematopoiesis, mouse reprogramming, and human primordial germ cell-like cell induction data. By exploiting the birth-diffusion coupling, scDIVIDE provides a biologically informed constraint on growth rate estimation, outperforming existing methods in predicting future cell distributions. scDIVIDE offers a conceptual avenue for quantitatively dissecting how cell division shapes fate decisions in multicellular systems.
items.summary_zh: scDIVIDE 将群体遗传学出生—死亡—突变过程与动态最优传输结合，从时间序列 scRNA-seq 推断分裂率和连续状态动力学。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本在合成数据及小鼠造血、重编程和人类原始生殖细胞样细胞诱导数据中评估，为增长率估计加入生物学约束；其对命运决定的解释仍是模型推断。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞分裂对多细胞生物至关重要，而细胞组分的随机分配可强烈影响全基因组基因表达。然而，细胞分裂相关随机性如何塑造细胞动力学仍不甚清楚。这里，我们提出 scDIVIDE，这是一个神经随机微分方程框架，用于从时间序列单细胞 RNA 测序数据中联合推断分裂率和连续细胞动力学。我们将群体遗传学中的出生—死亡—突变过程与动态最优传输结合，揭示出生（分裂）率嵌入在扩散系数中。scDIVIDE 在合成数据中准确推断出生率，且所推断的出生率重现了小鼠造血、小鼠重编程和人类原始生殖细胞样细胞诱导数据中的周转相关程序。通过利用出生—扩散耦合，scDIVIDE 为生长率估计提供了具有生物学依据的约束，在预测未来细胞分布方面优于现有方法。scDIVIDE 为定量剖析细胞分裂如何塑造多细胞系统中的命运决定提供了一条概念路径。
items.author_line: Okochi, Y., Sawazaki, Y., Kondo, Y., Naoki, H.

items.title: An agentic AI environment to support biomedical research in collaborative academic environments
items.abstract_or_text: Agentic artificial intelligence (AAI) is increasingly used by biomedical scientists, where it has substantially lowered the difficulty of integrating computational, statistical and data-science approaches into day-to-day research activities, assisting with project design, analysis and manuscript preparation. Significant barriers remain, however, which are unlikely to be removed solely by releasing more capable AI models. Meaningful use still demands a technical fluency that many biomedical researchers lack: a PI and their lab members must learn how to use the AAI system, establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for managing, sharing and curating data, and enforce rules that address data privacy and security. Existing commercial AAI systems, which were designed primarily for software engineering purposes, need to be significantly re-purposed for biomedical-related data science. We present Murmurent, shared software that sits beneath the agentic AI and provides the skills, procedures and protections to address the concerns above, removing the need for a lab to develop them independently. This includes (1) infrastructure to support projects and so-called choreographies} involving multiple group members; (2) a set of specialized agents each dedicated to typical biomedical data science tasks including software and statistical development, data visualization, literature search, equity, diversity, inclusion, and decolonization (EDID) review, and others; (3) a tiered memory which can retain important research decisions, intermediate, derived outputs and sensitive data, and which can exploit this information to automatically build better contexts in AAI sessions; (4) traceability records which are used by the AAI session to better plan and execute data analyses and software builds by, for example, helping to avoid repeating decisions that lead to dead-ends; (5) enforcement of SOPs for data maintenance and data governance across all lab members; and (6) multi-user capacity to allow groups to interact and collaborate. We use the system to identify putative inhibitors of Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans Isomerase NIMA-interacting 1 (Pin1), a protein with a shallow catalytic site making it difficult to target. We describe the construction of several approaches to identify Pin1 inhibitors and the results they yield. Murmurent is open source.
items.summary_zh: 开源 Murmurent 为协作型生物医学实验室提供智能体、分层记忆、可追溯性和数据治理，并用于探索 Pin1 抑制剂。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本关注可复现协作、隐私和 SOP 执行等实验室落地条件；Pin1 结果为候选探索，摘要未给出其抑制剂的实验效力验证。
items.abstract_zh: 智能体人工智能（AAI）正日益被生物医学科学家使用，它已大幅降低了将计算、统计和数据科学方法整合到日常研究活动中的难度，并辅助项目设计、分析和论文准备。然而，仍存在重大障碍，而且仅通过发布能力更强的 AI 模型不太可能消除这些障碍。有意义的使用仍要求许多生物医学研究人员所缺乏的技术熟练度：PI 及其实验室成员必须学习如何使用 AAI 系统，建立用于管理、共享和整理数据的标准操作程序（SOPs），并执行处理数据隐私和安全的规则。现有商业 AAI 系统主要为软件工程目的而设计，需要针对生物医学相关数据科学进行重大改造。我们提出 Murmurent，这是一种位于智能体 AI 之下的共享软件，提供解决上述问题所需的技能、程序和保护措施，使实验室无需独立开发这些内容。这包括：（1）支持项目及涉及多个组成员的所谓 choreographies 的基础设施；（2）一组专用智能体，每个智能体均专注于典型生物医学数据科学任务，包括软件和统计开发、数据可视化、文献检索、平等、多样性、包容性与去殖民化（EDID）审查等；（3）一种分层记忆，可保留重要研究决策、中间和衍生输出以及敏感数据，并可利用这些信息在 AAI 会话中自动构建更好的上下文；（4）可追溯性记录，AAI 会话利用其更好地规划和执行数据分析和软件构建，例如帮助避免重复导致死胡同的决策；（5）在全体实验室成员中执行数据维护和数据治理的 SOPs；以及（6）允许群组互动和协作的多用户能力。我们使用该系统识别 Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans Isomerase NIMA-interacting 1（Pin1）的推定抑制剂；该蛋白具有浅催化位点，因而难以靶向。我们描述了构建若干识别 Pin1 抑制剂的方法及其产生的结果。Murmurent 是开源的。
